salesCopy.tagline: A Knowledge System for Your Whole Life.
salesCopy.secondaryTagline: Less in your head, more done by your AI. My own Obsidian vault, ready to use: everything has a place, and your AI knows you and your work
salesCopy.problem: You've heard `Obsidian` is powerful. But every time you try to set it up, you hit the same wall: *where should notes go?* Which plugins matter? How do you structure this thing so it doesn't become another digital junk drawer? I've watched people spend **months** on this. Meanwhile, their lives stay spread across a task manager, a journaling app, a contacts app, a movie tracker and a running app, and their head is the only place where it all connects. Then they open an AI tool, and it starts from zero. Again.
problemPoints: **Weeks spent** on folder structure, only to scrap it when things don't fit
Trying **dozens of plugins** without knowing which actually matter
Building templates from scratch that **break after 50 notes**
Reading books about *Zettelkasten*, *PARA*, *GTD* but **struggling to implement** them in practice
**Juggling multiple apps**: task managers, journaling apps, contact tools and note apps that never talk to each other
**One app per hobby**: a movie tracker, a board game site, a practice app for your guitar and a running app, none of them linked to your notes
**Finished work piling up** next to what's still open, until your task list is more archive than plan
**AI tools that don't know you**: every prompt starts from zero, so you paste the same context again and again and still get generic output
salesCopy.agitate: The real cost isn't the setup time. It's the **mental load**. Every open loop, every *where did I put that?*, every commitment you're afraid to forget stays in your head, because no system you trust holds it for you. That's where the **constant anxiety** comes from: the feeling that important ideas are slipping through the cracks. AI doesn't fix it on its own. A tool that doesn't know who you are, what you're working on or how you write is one more thing to manage. I spent years organizing information at scale, and I built my vault to take that load off my mind.
agitatePoints: That **nagging feeling** that you captured something important but can't find it
Your brain becomes the **only connection point** between scattered tools
**Decisions everywhere**: where does this note go, what's its status, is this project done or just forgotten?
**Analysis paralysis** from too many options and no clear path
**Lost connections**: you can't remember who introduced that idea, who you discussed it with, or what you learned from whom
**A three-page prompt** every time you want AI to help with your work, because it knows nothing about you
**AI answers evaporating**: good AI conversations lost the moment you close the tab, because they live outside your notes
salesCopy.solution: The Obsidian Starter Kit is the vault I run my business from every day, without my personal content. It's a knowledge system for your whole life, built in three layers. **The foundation: everything has a place.** Every kind of note has a type, a template, properties and a folder, and automation files and archives your work for you. Nothing to decide, nothing to remember. **The life systems: your whole life in one place.** Your knowledge, your goals and tasks, your journal, the people you know, what you create, who you are, and since **v6**, what you watch, play, practice and train. **The AI layer: your AI knows you and your work.** The structure that keeps your head clear is the same structure your AI reads, so it can do the work for you: research, writing, planning, running your projects and your business processes. You decide what. Your AI handles how.
solutionPoints: **Everything has a place**: every kind of note has a type, a template, properties and a folder. Pick the template and the note files itself
**Finished work files itself**: statuses stamp their dates, and done actions move to the archive on their own, so your lists show what's still open
**Your daily note becomes your cockpit**: buttons for the things you do every day, captures that write to the right section, and Bases that take you to everything else
**Reviews keep it current**: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes share one shape, so looking back and planning ahead takes minutes

**New in v6, a sturdier foundation**: renames keep your links and your lists, link checks show what points nowhere, Kanban boards handle thousands of cards (and work on your phone), and large vaults stay fast. In French and on macOS too
**Your goals and your to-do list finally talk to each other**: ideas, goals, plans, projects, activities and tasks link up, with Kanban boards, an ideal week and time budgets
**Your notes compound**: content curation, *Zettelkasten*, Dots, Maps of Content and LLM Wikis turn what you read into permanent notes you can reuse
**People, creations and identity**: contacts, meetings and interactions, a creation pipeline from idea to published, and notes about who you are, your voice and your routines

**New in v6, life outside work**: the movies, shows, games and board games you own, the instrument you're learning (with mastery levels and spaced review), and session notes whose minutes count toward your activities on their own
**Your AI knows you and your work**: your identity, goals, projects, processes and voice live in one place, so it can research, write, plan and run your projects without a three-page prompt
**One context for every AI tool**: `Claude Code`, `Codex`, `Gemini` or a chat AI all work from the same notes. Switch tools and your context stays
**Agents, skills, panels and memory, ready on day one**: the OSK plugin exposes your note types through a CLI and an `MCP` server, and review panels catch generic output before it lands in your notes

**New in v6, more for your AI to work with**: skills for your creations, skills that change your QuickAdd, Meta Bind, Dataview Serializer and Templater setup without breaking it, and bundles of notes for chat AIs
**You decide what, your AI handles how**: you can hand over the work, not the understanding. And it all stays in plain Markdown files on your machine, with or without AI
salesCopy.description: I've been passionate about knowledge management for more than **20 years**. I run my business from this vault every day (writing, the community, plugin development, the lot), and the Obsidian Starter Kit is that vault without my personal content. When something proves itself in my daily work, it lands in the next release. That's why the kit keeps getting better: I'm its most demanding user! It's built for you AND for your AI. The foundation gives everything a place, so nothing stays in your head. The life systems hold your whole life: notes and learning, goals and tasks, your journal, people, creations and identity. And because all of it is structured, your AI knows you and your work, and can do the work for you. **Version 6 is here**, and each layer got something. The foundation got sturdier: renames no longer break your links or your lists, and the Kanban boards handle thousands of cards (and work on your phone). The system now goes past your work: your movies, shows, games and board games, the instrument you're learning and your workouts get their own notes. And your AI got more to work with: skills for your creations and for the plugins behind your buttons. Already on v5? You upgrade without starting over. The rule behind the AI layer is simple: **you can hand over the work, not the understanding**. Your AI does the work; you choose what gets done, and you stay the one who understands it. **${stats.userCount} people** use the kit, sold and improved since 2022. Want proof? My [free public notes](https://notes.dsebastien.net/) are built and shared with OSK. And if you'd rather learn the foundations first, start with my [Knowledge Management for Beginners](/product/knowledge-management-for-beginners) course.

originStory.title: Why I Built the Obsidian Starter Kit
originStory.subtitle: 20+ Years of Knowledge Management, Distilled
originStory.story: For over two decades, I've been obsessed with one question: How do we capture, organize, and use knowledge without losing our minds? I've tried every tool, every methodology, every system. I've failed spectacularly (many times) and refined relentlessly. Eventually, I learned my lessons and ended up with a solid system. A system that scaled from my first notes to 10K+, that grew with my career as an author, blogger, and entrepreneur, that made me more capable every single day. But it wasn't until I watched others struggle with the same chaos I had overcome (spending months recreating mistakes I'd already solved) that I realized this system needed to be shared. The Obsidian Starter Kit isn't a product I built to sell. It's the system I use every day, packaged so you don't have to spend years figuring it out yourself.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Watching talented people waste months on problems I had already solved

creatorJourney.title: My Journey Through Knowledge Chaos
creatorJourney.subtitle: From Scattered Notes to Systematic Mastery
creatorJourney.story: Before I had this system, I lived with constant background anxiety. Important ideas would slip away. I'd capture something brilliant and never find it again. My information was scattered across tools that never talked to each other. And I was the only connection point, relying on my memory to bridge the gaps. The creative blocks were the worst part. I knew I had the pieces, but I couldn't connect them. I felt less competent than I should have been, struggling to use my own thinking. Sound familiar? That's exactly why I spent years refining this system. So you don't have to. Today, I use OSK daily with AI tools like Claude, and my knowledge genuinely compounds. Every note I create makes me more capable. That's how I've been able to write hundreds of articles, newsletters, books, and share a [free public knowledge base](https://notes.dsebastien.net/) full of everything I've learned about knowledge management. That's what I want for you.

methodology.title: The OSK Philosophy
methodology.subtitle: Seven Principles That Make Knowledge Work

steps.title: Systems Over Willpower
steps.description: The system does the work, not your discipline or memory. Templates auto-file. Tags auto-organize. You focus on thinking, not housekeeping. When organization is automatic, consistency becomes natural.

steps.title: Opinionated But Flexible
steps.description: Every decision has been made for you. But nothing is locked. You get a complete, working system from day one with no analysis paralysis. As you learn, customize anything. But you don't have to customize anything to be productive.

steps.title: Built to Evolve
steps.description: OSK isn't static. It grows and adapts as your needs change, as new tools emerge, as AI gets better. Free lifetime updates mean your system evolves with you.

steps.title: Knowledge Compounds
steps.description: Every note should make you more capable, not just more organized. OSK is built around connecting ideas across time, projects, and domains. Your second brain should make your first brain smarter.

steps.title: AI Augments, Never Replaces
steps.description: You stay the author, curator, and decision-maker. AI handles the busywork: filing, linking, research legwork, first drafts. The identity layer, source provenance, and review panels keep AI output grounded in your notes and your voice. You can outsource the labor; you can't outsource your understanding.

steps.title: Documentation-Driven
steps.description: A deep user guide covers foundations, integrated systems, theory, step-by-step tutorials, and reference materials. You're never stuck wondering how something works or what to do next.

steps.title: One System, Many Tools
steps.description: OSK replaces fragmented apps with one integrated system. Your journaling connects to your tasks connects to your contacts connects to your knowledge, and your movies, games, music practice and workouts sit in the same graph. Information flows instead of getting stuck in silos.

methodology.philosophy: Most PKM systems fail because they require constant effort to maintain. OSK works because the system works for you, freeing your energy for what actually matters: thinking, creating, growing. The same stance drives the AI layer: AI removes the boring parts of knowledge work so your time goes to the parts that actually need a human. A vault written entirely by AI is a knowledge base with no knower; OSK is built to make sure that never happens to yours.
methodology.differentiation: Unlike templates that give you empty structures or tutorials that leave you to figure out implementation, OSK is a complete, working and battle-tested system. It is based on techniques I've refined and mastered over 20+ years. It's not theory. It's what I actually use every single day.

vision.title: Where This Takes You
vision.subtitle: The Future of Your Knowledge
vision.mission: Your knowledge should compound like interest. Every insight builds on the last, every note makes you more capable. OSK gives you that compounding advantage, whether you have 10 notes or 10,000. My goal is to help you become a systematic creator: someone who produces consistently, connects ideas naturally, and grows through their knowledge rather than drowning in it.

values.title: Clarity Over Complexity
values.description: A system should bring clarity, not add another layer of complexity. OSK simplifies knowledge work by making organization invisible.

values.title: Growth Over Perfection
values.description: Your system doesn't need to be perfect to work. OSK is designed for iteration. Start simple, evolve naturally.

values.title: Action Over Accumulation
values.description: Collecting notes is worthless if you never use them. OSK prioritizes retrieval, connection, and creation. Not just capture.

values.title: AI-Native, Human First
values.description: AI is changing knowledge work. OSK ships a full AI assistant system: agents, skills, LLM Wikis and an identity layer, and it loads only the skills a task needs. AI does the plumbing so you can do the thinking. Your vault stays yours; your thinking stays yours.

futureGoals: Help you reach 10,000+ notes with zero chaos
Let you write and create directly from your knowledge
Give you a real AI assistant: agents, skills and wikis that know your system and know you
Give you confidence that your system will serve you for life
vision.biggerPicture: In a world of information overload, the people who thrive are those who can capture, connect, and use knowledge systematically. OSK is your foundation for becoming one of them.
